title: Kafka and event streaming
description: Conventions for Kafka and event streaming.

rules.title: Schema registry
rules.text: Define event schemas in a registry and evolve them compatibly.

rules.title: Partition keys
rules.text: Choose partition keys that preserve per-entity ordering and spread load.

rules.title: Idempotent consumers
rules.text: Make consumers idempotent because delivery is at least once.

rules.title: Dead-letter handling
rules.text: Route poison messages to a dead-letter topic with context.

rules.title: Commit after processing
rules.text: Commit offsets only after the message has been processed.

rules.title: Idempotent producer
rules.text: Keep the idempotent producer on (the default since Kafka 3.0) and do not add application-level resends, which cannot be deduplicated.

rules.title: Durable topics
rules.text: Use replication factor 3 with min.insync.replicas 2 and acks=all for topics that must not lose data.
